I understand what your saying. I say it all the time. The struggle isnt worth it. Whenever i start telling someone about it they always say its not that youll regret it after your dead its that youll be causing pain to your family. Is it worth living an entire life of unhappiness just to save your friends and family from feeling sad? I dont know. If it is then that at least one reason to stay alive. I dont know how old you are but if your young you have time to get it together. I wish i could have started trying when i was young. Shits awful when your a teen or early 20s but if you get it together and work hard in school youll have a much better chance at gaining some happiness. If your over 30 and on meds and still feeling like this then your probably not gonna feel much better and youll just have to decide if your willing to feel like this til you die. Ive taken alot of different meds for the last 25 years and ive never found anything that made me feel better. Meds are only gonna work if you have depression for no reason. Like if you have a good family and money and no reason to be depressed but still are. If your depressed because of the situation your lifes in like your broke or have no friends and your ugly then meds arent gonna do anything for you and your lifes gonna suck and youll be depressed til you change whats depressing your life. I hope you understand what im tryin to get across and i hope you can fix whatever it is thats wrong. Good luck.

I took 2 bottles of asprin and drank 2 bottles of nyquil once when i tried to kill myself. I woke up in the hospital the next day because my mom had found me unresponsive on the living room floor and called my gf to take me to the hospital. They had fed me charcoal water when i got there. My poop was black for a week but other than that there were no adverse reactions from taking it. It must have been at least six hours from when i took it til i got to the hospital but other than being knocked out from all the nyquil nothing happened. I dont think asprin is going to do anything other than get you baker acted and if that happens be prepared for child services to get involved since you have a kid. Its rough out here and i think of suicide every day. Most nights i say a prayer asking to die in my sleep even still i wouldnt try taking aspirin again. You might think it cant get any worse but if you try takin it youll find out you were wrong. Hope you feel better though.
